HARD_FIX (Greptile tip_match review 28132251, P1): pip-audit's `--strict` flag does not impose a HIGH+ severity floor — it only fails the run on dependency-*resolution* errors — and pip-audit has no severity flag at all, so the pre-fix step hard-failed the job on any LOW/MEDIUM finding in a PR-added requirements*.txt, contrary to this gate's stated HIGH+/CRITICAL policy.
